trigger_event: Lebanon front active kinetic — IDF strike campaign, Haifa rockets

lebanon-_root.description: Lebanon front active kinetic — IDF strike campaign, Haifa rockets

7fdbf4c1.description: Hezbollah targets Israeli energy infrastructure and gas platforms in the Mediterranean.

sector_impacts.notes: Regional supply risk premium spikes due to potential loss of Leviathan/Tamar fields.
War risk premiums for Mediterranean maritime assets surge.

f86460cd.description: Kinetic activity disrupts operations at Haifa Port and disrupts container shipping lanes.

sector_impacts.notes: Vessel diversions and port congestion as Haifa becomes a combat zone.
Increased premiums for cargo entering Eastern Mediterranean.

6065db89.description: Iranian proxies initiate retaliatory actions in the Persian Gulf to stretch IDF/US resources.

sector_impacts.notes: Fear of supply shock triggers aggressive oil price rally.
Freight rates spike for VLCCs due to increased risk in Hormuz.
Flight to safety increases USD demand.

ac4a7b3b.description: Successful kinetic strikes on Leviathan or Tamar gas platforms lead to immediate production halts and infrastructure damage.

sector_impacts.notes: Disruption of Eastern Med gas supply triggers regional price spikes.
Immediate surge in war-risk premiums for Mediterranean offshore assets.

1889bdf5.description: IDF launches massive retaliatory strikes targeting Lebanese power grids and fuel storage facilities.

sector_impacts.notes: Increased demand for missile defense munitions and surveillance tech.
Increased risk premium on Lebanese and regional sovereign debt.

3d8d359e.description: Maritime insurance underwriters designate the Eastern Mediterranean as a high-risk zone, causing shipping reroutes.

sector_impacts.notes: Higher freight rates due to increased insurance costs and longer routes.
Operational disruptions in Eastern Med ports.
Sharp increase in hull and machinery (H&M) and P&I war risk premiums.

0280ccee.description: Marine insurers declare the Eastern Mediterranean a high-risk zone, triggering immediate vessel diversions from Haifa to alternative regional hubs.

sector_impacts.notes: Freight rates spike due to rerouting and congestion at alternative ports.
War risk premiums surge for all vessels entering the Levantine Basin.

44629f52.description: Escalation of kinetic activity leads to threats against offshore gas platforms and energy infrastructure in the Mediterranean.

sector_impacts.notes: Regional instability adds a geopolitical risk premium to Brent crude.
Increased risk premium on Israeli government bonds.

1e810d9c.description: Rapid depreciation of the Israeli Shekel and flight to safety in currency markets as conflict intensity persists.

sector_impacts.notes: Sharp decline in ILS value against USD due to instability.
Increased demand for interceptor missiles and short-term defense contracts.

ae098729.description: Proxy forces deploy sea mines and drone swarms in the Strait of Hormuz to disrupt global oil transit.

sector_impacts.notes: Immediate risk premium added to Brent crude due to transit uncertainty.
Spot rates spike as vessels avoid the area or require high-risk premiums.
War risk premiums for Gulf transit surge instantly.

a2890eeb.description: Targeted drone strikes hit critical oil processing and export terminals in Saudi Arabia or UAE.

sector_impacts.notes: Direct supply shock from infrastructure damage.
Increased risk profile for GCC sovereign debt.
Claims surge for industrial asset coverage.

88ebdcaf.description: US CENTCOM initiates preemptive kinetic strikes against proxy launch sites and command centers in the region.

sector_impacts.notes: Increased demand for precision munitions and surveillance assets.
Flight to safety drives USD strength against regional currencies.

4a2baf9a.description: Hezbollah launches saturation drone and missile strikes targeting Haifa port and Israeli energy refineries in retaliation.

sector_impacts.notes: Risk premium increase due to potential disruption of Eastern Mediterranean energy hubs.
War risk premiums for Mediterranean shipping routes spike.
Increased demand for missile defense interceptors.

d8cd543b.description: Total collapse of the Lebanese power grid and fuel distribution leads to widespread civil unrest and humanitarian crisis.

sector_impacts.notes: Lebanese sovereign debt risk reaches extreme levels as state functionality ceases.
Political risk insurance payouts triggered for regional assets.

9d533b23.description: Major shipping lines divert container traffic from Haifa to Piraeus and Limassol, leading to immediate port congestion and logistics bottlenecks.

sector_impacts.notes: Increased freight rates due to rerouting and congestion surcharges.
War risk premiums spike for Eastern Med transit.

0f08aa2e.description: Severe congestion and logistical bottlenecks emerge at alternative regional hubs, specifically Limassol and Piraeus, due to sudden vessel influx.

sector_impacts.notes: Spot rates increase due to diversion costs and port congestion surcharges.
Increased demand for short-haul shuttle services to move cargo from hubs to Israel.

3f13ccbf.description: War risk premiums surge across the entire Eastern Mediterranean basin, leading to a partial 'effective closure' for smaller, non-specialized carriers.

sector_impacts.notes: Rapid adjustment of premiums for all vessels entering the Levant basin.
Increased costs for tankers servicing the region.

21766034.description: Kinetic strikes on or near Haifa port lead to operational suspension and shipping diversions.

sector_impacts.notes: Disruption of cargo throughput at primary Israeli gateway.
War risk premiums spike for East Mediterranean transit.

38124687.description: Successful strikes on Haifa refineries cause significant production outages and regional energy price volatility.

sector_impacts.notes: Immediate spike in regional benchmarks due to infrastructure damage.
Increase in war-risk premiums for Eastern Mediterranean assets.

69066108.description: Haifa port declares force majeure and ceases operations due to direct hits and safety protocols.

sector_impacts.notes: Disruption of key Mediterranean hub operations.
Diversion of bulk shipments to alternative ports.

56e40c0c.description: Israel initiates a massive retaliatory air campaign targeting Hezbollah launch sites and logistics hubs in Lebanon.

sector_impacts.notes: Increased demand for missile defense munitions.
Increased risk premium on Israeli government bonds.

8785263d.description: Hezbollah launches retaliatory strikes against Israeli offshore gas platforms and power infrastructure to mirror the Lebanese collapse.

sector_impacts.notes: Risk premium spike due to potential disruption of Eastern Mediterranean gas exports.
War risk premiums for Mediterranean shipping and energy assets surge.
Increased demand for missile defense systems in the region.

c1f6b06d.description: Massive civilian displacement toward the Syrian border and Mediterranean ports creates a regional humanitarian crisis.

sector_impacts.notes: Lebanese sovereign debt becomes virtually untradeable as state functions cease.
Hyper-collapse of the Lebanese Pound (LBP) as trust vanishes.

25fd36fa.description: Local militias and non-state actors seize control of remaining fuel depots and power hubs to establish parallel governance.

sector_impacts.notes: Political risk insurance premiums for the Levant region increase.
Reduced throughput at regional ports due to instability and insecurity.

d8c3c3b2.description: Severe congestion at Piraeus and Limassol ports triggers a sharp increase in regional maritime insurance premiums and container freight spot rates.

sector_impacts.notes: War risk premiums expand to cover Eastern Mediterranean transit.
Short-term spike in regional spot rates due to capacity constraints.

81bedc79.description: Hezbollah escalates kinetic strikes to target Haifa port infrastructure directly, rendering the facility completely non-operational.

sector_impacts.notes: Increased demand for missile defense systems.
Immediate re-rating of all assets in the Levant.

0869f0e4.description: Prolonged disruption of Israel's primary commercial gateway leads to increased sovereign risk and volatility in the Shekel.

sector_impacts.notes: Capital flight due to economic instability and trade paralysis.
CDS spreads widen as trade capacity drops.

e9a586cf.description: Marine insurance underwriters implement emergency 'War Risk' surcharges for the Eastern Mediterranean basin due to kinetic activity and port instability.

sector_impacts.notes: Rapid increase in premiums for vessels calling at Piraeus and Limassol.
Freight rates increase to cover insurance surcharges.

79291605.description: Shipping lines initiate wide-scale diversion of cargo to Western Mediterranean hubs (e.g., Valencia, Algeciras) to bypass Eastern Med bottlenecks.

sector_impacts.notes: Increased ton-mile demand and operational costs due to longer routing.
Secondary impact on regional fuel distribution logistics.

625a86d1.description: Regional energy price volatility spikes in Cyprus and Greece as logistical bottlenecks delay critical fuel and LNG imports.

sector_impacts.notes: Local spot prices rise due to supply chain friction.
Pressure on regional economic stability.

4e45cc79.description: Sustained kinetic strikes on Haifa and Beirut ports lead to total cessation of commercial port operations.

sector_impacts.notes: Immediate halt of cargo throughput in key Eastern Med hubs.
War risk premiums spike for all vessels entering the Levant basin.

c073259b.description: Escalation to targeting of offshore energy assets in the Levant Basin to disrupt economic stability.

sector_impacts.notes: Supply risk premium added to regional gas exports.
Increased demand for maritime and point-defense systems.

9d66ed85.description: Major global carriers implement full diversion of schedules, bypassing the Eastern Mediterranean entirely.

sector_impacts.notes: Increased ton-mile demand due to rerouting around the conflict zone.
Operational inefficiency and increased fuel costs for diverted fleets.

56a67ca3.description: War risk premiums surge for Eastern Mediterranean ports, causing widespread shipping diversions and congestion at alternative hubs.

sector_impacts.notes: Rapid increase in hull and machinery (H&M) and war risk premiums for East Med transit.
Increased freight rates due to rerouting and port congestion.

ce845dc3.description: Kinetic strikes expand to target fuel storage and energy terminals adjacent to the Haifa port area.

sector_impacts.notes: Regional supply shock and risk premium on Mediterranean oil flows.
Specific energy-infrastructure risk premiums triggered.

9c338073.description: Prolonged suspension of the primary commercial gateway triggers volatility in Israeli sovereign bonds and currency.

sector_impacts.notes: Increased risk premium on Israeli government bonds due to economic disruption.
Downward pressure on Shekel due to trade instability.

tombstones.description: Global energy markets react to the loss of Eastern Med gas production, causing a spike in regional LNG spot prices and volatility in the Israeli Shekel.
IDF launches symmetric retaliatory strikes targeting Lebanese power grids and fuel storage facilities to degrade Hezbollah's operational capacity.
Insurance underwriters and shipping firms designate the Eastern Mediterranean as a high-risk zone, leading to rerouting or increased freight costs.
Iran accelerates shipments of advanced weaponry via Syria to replenish Hezbollah's depleted stockpiles.
Kinetic strikes target Haifa's industrial zone, causing direct damage to energy storage and refinery infrastructure.
Non-state actors target a commercial vessel in the designated high-risk zone to signal capability, leading to a temporary maritime blockade.
Kinetic strikes directly target Haifa port infrastructure, transitioning the risk from financial/insurance-based to physical operational failure.
Kinetic strikes successfully target offshore gas platforms, causing immediate production halts and physical damage.
Operators implement preemptive operational shutdowns of offshore platforms to protect personnel and assets.
Underwriters declare the Eastern Mediterranean a high-risk zone, leading to shipping rerouting and increased freight costs.
Sovereign credit rating agencies place Israeli debt on negative watch due to currency instability and war costs.
Escalation fears trigger volatility in East Mediterranean gas infrastructure and energy pricing.
Global shipping firms declare Force Majeure and insurance premiums for Persian Gulf transit spike exponentially.
US Navy and coalition forces initiate large-scale mine-countermeasure (MCM) operations to clear shipping lanes.
Kinetic retaliation by US/IDF targeting Iranian naval command centers and drone launch sites.
Immediate surge in global crude prices and spike in maritime insurance premiums for Persian Gulf transit.
Targeted oil processing facilities enter emergency shutdown for damage assessment and repair.
Regional naval forces implement restrictive transit protocols in the Strait of Hormuz to intercept further drone threats.
Proxy forces launch coordinated drone and missile retaliations against US military installations in Iraq and Syria.
Strategic strikes target regional energy infrastructure to leverage US political pressure.
Iranian-backed naval assets implement a tactical blockade or harassment campaign in the Bab el-Mandeb and Hormuz.
